hindsight.changed_choice: If confirmed settings differ from every approved phase-5 arm, add its one-head reference on seeds 42--61 at all registered points and revise the forecast before approval.

temperature.rationale: Across the representable integer range 1..24, the priority-statistics rule cannot reach mean-acceptance targets 3/4, 1/2 or 1/4: the pooled pilot curves remain at least 0.90 on every maze and K. T=1, the predecessor setting, accepted 99.69--99.97% of proposals and is practically the T=0 control already in the grid. T=24 is the strongest prioritization available in the registered range; tuning between them would mostly repeat the registered VCP-minus-control comparison.

final_grid.temperature: T=24 fixed for both prioritized arms; T=0 for both controls; no tuning stage

references.rule: reuse verified approved archives; never rerun

identity_checks.rule: Before accepting grid results, all seed-42 pilot-overlapping nominal points reproduce every learning, evaluation and knowledge field of each matching arm and temperature. Compare the validation block, since the pilot evaluated validation only. Prioritized arms retain every existing portable counter and priority field; controls remove exactly the independently counted value queries and classifier tests, satisfy formations=steps+3*full+2*values_only with zero priority queries, and report no training variance. Additive diagnostics and target-native inline headers are checked separately.
identity_checks.missing_scope: Maze6 T=24 has no pilot identity oracle; the unchanged core/HER pins and joint-volume identities still apply. T=1 pilot rows are not a T=24 oracle.

analysis.seed_unit: seed, averaging heads inside the seed
analysis.summaries: mean and SE over twenty seeds
analysis.paired_interval: marginal 95% Student t(19), critical value 2.093024054408263, without multiplicity correction
analysis.threshold_rule: First registered nominal point reaching each exact archived final-mean test threshold. Recover integer counts per head, divide by heads*test pairs, and use Fraction for seed means and comparisons; no interpolation.

execution.guards: clean frozen musl measurement, mechanical manifests before sbatch, grant and test-only before each submission, node guards and STOP; no lease, host pinning or laptop automation
execution.admission: pilots + all attempted allocation CPUTimeRAW + outstanding hard reservations + new limits <= the approved limit
execution.scope: All four arms, six mazes, twenty seeds and nine comparisons are fixed. The user sets the CPU-hour limit at approval; no automatic sixty-hour trigger or arm reduction.

forecast.maze6_ratio_metric: allocation CPUTimeRAW T=24 divided by T=1; maximum over the five measured mazes separately for K=2 and K=4
forecast.control_scale: classifier-perception tests at the same registered seed-42 checkpoint; no timing ratio
forecast.added_evaluation_rule: Additional training/test policies charged at every pair times cap, plus disagreement queries for all three blocks, times the pilot training wall seconds per classifier-perception test. Sum the pilot head populations at every registered point; scale the missing Maze6 T=24 estimate by its same-K cost ratio.
forecast.limitations: One seed, short control calibration and a missing Maze6 T=24 pilot are forecasts, not guaranteed costs; actual limits and accounting govern admission.

measurement_evidence.validity: The priority distribution, populations, update steps, acting/evaluation streams and all old learning/evaluation/knowledge fields remain pinned. T=0 skips only unused training value queries; the separate observer and immutable evaluation diagnostics consume no learner randomness. Header-preserving measurement sidecars account for their additional memory separately.
